title: Budget
description: The limits of one run of model work. The first limit that the run reaches ends it. Money is an integer count of millionths of a US dollar, never a floating-point amount. An absent limit is no limit.

costCapMicroUsd.description: The cost cap of the model calls, in millionths of a US dollar (1000000 is 1 USD).

tokenLimit.description: The most tokens (input and output) that the run may use.

wallClockSeconds.description: The longest time that the run may take.

depth.description: The named depth that set the other limits, for example `quick`, `standard`, `deep` or `max`.

reservation.title: ReservationPolicy
reservation.description: How the model gateway keeps a run inside its cost cap. `worst_case`: before each upstream call, the call reserves its worst-case cost (its request and its completion ceiling at the prices of its policy); a call that cannot fit is refused and never goes upstream. `none`: the gateway counts the cost after each call only.

softStopFraction.description: The fraction of the cost cap after which no new work starts; the running work finishes in the rest.

holdWaitSeconds.description: How long a call that fits only after the calls in flight settle waits for them.
